business.description: PAVNA is engaged in manufacturing of wide range of automotive components for reputed Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) as per their requirements primarily catering to various vehicle segments, including, passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, three-wheelers, heavy and light commercial vehicles and off-road vehicles. The Company along with its subsidiaries has a diversified product portfolio, which consists of high-quality reliable parts such as Ignition Switches, Fuel Tank Caps, Latches, Auto Locks, Handles, Switches, Oil Pump, Carburettor, Throttle Body, Fuel Cocks, Injection System, Casting Components etc. PAVNA also provide aftermarket sales and services.

outlook.statement: Pavna is preparing itself for the next phase of growth. The current dip in EBITDA and PAT margins is, in large measure, a result of the investments we are making today to build the Company for tomorrow. We remain firmly committed to our growth strategy, and we believe that the benefits of these investments will become increasingly visible in the near future.
Construction of the Hosur facility has commenced, and we expect the plant to be completed and operational in Q3 of FY 2026-27.
Joint Venture with SMC Microchip will focus on future technologies in the field of electronic locks.
R&D Centre in Noida started exploring opportunities in the field of electronics.

The global economy showed significant resilience during FY 2025–2026, with activity exceeding initial baseline expectations despite localized geopolitical tensions and trade policy realignments. Global real GDP growth reached 3.4% in calendar 2025, surpassing the IMF's previous forecast. The overall disinflationary trend continued as global headline inflation decreased from roughly 6.8% in 2023 to about 4.1% in 2025. Important regional economies showed remarkable resilience throughout 2025. The United States maintained robust economic activity and achieved real GDP growth of 2.1% in 2025.

For automotive component and engineering companies, India's resilient domestic demand, expanding manufacturing ecosystem and continued infrastructure investment provide a supportive environment for growth, while global supply-chain diversification creates additional opportunities for export-oriented businesses.
Global real GDP is expected to grow by 3.0% in 2026 and 3.4% in 2027, while global trade volume is expected to grow by 3.5% in 2026 and 4.3% in 2027.
India's real GDP growth will be between 6.4% and 6.6%, with the IMF predicting 6.4% and the RBI 6.6%.

The Indian auto component industry is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by favorable policy frameworks like the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme, deeper global supply-chain integration, and increasing localization of advanced vehicle technologies.

The proposed transaction is expected to unlock value for shareholders; optimize the Company's investment portfolio; improve capital efficiency and liquidity; enable redeployment of resources toward core business operations and strategic growth initiatives; and strengthen the Company's balance sheet.

The proceeds from the sale of SSPL shall be utilized by the Company in strengthening its core business and can be reinvested in higher-growth two-wheeler or three-wheeler auto industry opportunities, ultimately benefiting the shareholders.

The proceeds from the sale of PAEPL shall be utilized by the Company in strengthening its core business and can be reinvested in higher-growth two-wheeler or three-wheeler auto industry opportunities, ultimately benefiting the shareholders.
